---
name: update
description: Review, test, commit, and push the intended project changes
---

Review the current Git branch and working-tree changes. Inspect the diff, run the relevant tests, and commit the intended changes with a clear commit message. Push the commit to the current branch on GitHub only after the checks pass.

Do not include secrets, generated files, or unrelated changes. If it is unclear which changes are intended, ask me before staging or committing. Report the files changed, checks run, commit hash, and push result. Do not amend existing commits.
